kind16_nested_contract.canonicality: every nested object is exact-order and deny-unknown; the four usage arrays share one aggregate cap, nonce watermarks have per-key and aggregate caps, and the total cap counts nested nonce watermarks; future_candidate_registrations is omitted when empty and may be present only when nonempty

bidirectional_projection_contract.exact_decode_order: every physical namespace-8 entry is envelope-checked and kind-specific exact-decoded before kind-16 companion reconstruction or reverse-orphan analysis, matching the Rust production projection constructor
bidirectional_projection_contract.kind16_companions: consumer keys, nonce watermarks, meter policies, funded-unused reservations, active certificates, provider registration histories, pending challenges, and pending/final governance records are re-derived from their exact raw semantic entries; usage windows are re-derived from the active epoch and meter span
bidirectional_projection_contract.active_certificate_join: the raw certificate and strict consumer Ed25519 signature, key interval, provider nonce watermark, meter task/output/evidence policy, unique tuple, consumed settlement, measurement, relationship expiry at both billing end and acceptance, provider-registration provenance, lifecycle, and exact retained semantic-key set {1,4,6,7,12} must all agree
bidirectional_projection_contract.relationship_exception: kind 8 relationship classifications may exist independently and are not globally orphan-rejected, but every such physical entry is still kind-specific exact-decoded before companion analysis

contribution_projection.relationship: only independent contributes; related, reciprocal, and unresolved contribute zero
contribution_projection.candidate_membership: a retained certificate whose provider is outside the final candidate universe remains valid history but is projected with eligible=false
contribution_projection.historical_epoch: finalized_epoch is reconstructed from accepted_height and immutable v0 epoch geometry; it is never relabeled as the current epoch

bond_and_jail.bond: amount contributes only for active_slashable and checked target_epoch + evidence_window_epochs < locked_until; absence, unbonding, equality, and shorter locks contribute zero
bond_and_jail.jail: jailed exactly when target_epoch < jailed_until; absence is unjailed only after completeness of the full projection is established

canonical_seals.fallback: fallback suppresses B2-G diagnostics but remains bound to the complete source transcript and rejected candidate parameters

fixture_evidence.source: continuous raw physical write history with one Rust-recorded JMT root per version plus raw cutoff/head projections
fixture_evidence.independent_consumer: Node independently recomputes every jmt 0.12.0 SHA-256 root from the continuous physical writes, proves exact namespace-8 physical completeness at cutoff and head, exact-decodes every kind 1 through 16 payload before companion analysis, and reconstructs application authority, candidates, contributions, strict PoP verification, B2-G, canonical seals, and expected outcome from raw source facts
fixture_evidence.lossless_integer_policy: kind-16 canonical JSON uses unquoted u64 decimal integers over the full 0..2^64-1 range; Node preserves unsafe values as BigInt, emits them unquoted for byte-identical re-encoding, and rejects floats, exponents, signs, leading zeros, overflow, or reformatting
fixture_evidence.rust_consumer: the same canonical semantic corpus is independently reconstructed through ProcessProposal and FinalizeBlock, SQLite restart, cache miss and hit, V3 parent restore, V4 cutoff-25 restore followed by parent 27, and post-checkpoint fresh reconstruction; zero-hash rejection preserves head, pending state, and retained cutoff state; a targeted call to the existing safe pruning authority physically deletes the SQLite height-25 root and advances the retained query floor to 26, after which ProcessProposal rejects and FinalizeBlock fail-stops with the exact pruned-cutoff error while head, pending state, parent state, floor, and two restarts remain unchanged; this production read/rejection test does not establish normal scheduled pruning
fixture_evidence.required_positive: at least four candidates with mature independent contributions and reason 0
fixture_evidence.required_fallback: a complete valid authenticated projection with insufficient eligible candidates and the exact frozen fallback reason
fixture_evidence.fixture_only_boundary: the height-24 epoch-2 source bootstrap used to install the unified cutoff-25 semantic source is test-only evidence setup and is not an application or Core production epoch transition
